test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘GARDEN’ is written as ‘FYOEGQ’ and ‘GOLDEN’ is written as ‘FMIEGQ’. How will ‘ISLAND’ be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern followed is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

‘GARDEN’ is written as ‘FYOEGQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2931ff920729da6b36d06780aa76338235158ebf0a38f0d1ae575e2b425f35d.png] 

‘GOLDEN’ is written as ‘FMIEGQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e6fc12e7ac81601164a7af21b8ef9c48b20d7ae6d18b268ecb6b79dfe0cfe78.png] 

Similarly, for ‘ISLAND’:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c9bd73c19aafecc9bdf4f3a2eb3b9983de4453bbfef2185679ffbb31cb1439e.png] 

 Hence, the correct answer is **"HQIBPG"**.
